# discord_application_role_connection_metadata (Resource)

Manages the full set of role connection metadata records for an application. Discord replaces all records on every write, so this resource owns the entire list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_application_role_connection_metadata" "this" {
  application_id = "123456789012345678"

  records = [
    {
      type        = 2 # INTEGER_GREATER_THAN_OR_EQUAL
      key         = "level"
      name        = "Level"
      description = "Minimum account level"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the application. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `records` (Attributes List) Up to 5 metadata records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Required:

- `description` (String) Description of the metadata field (max 200).
- `key` (String) Dictionary key for the metadata field (a-z, 0-9, _; max 50).
- `name` (String) Display name of the metadata field (max 100).
- `type` (Number) Metadata type (1-8): comparison operator applied to the value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported using the application snowflake ID.
terraform import discord_application_role_connection_metadata.this 123456789012345678
```
